content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RARI Pune Project Technical Support II Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RARI Pune Project Technical Support II Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: This recruitment is through a walk-in interview, so there is no application last date. Eligible candidates can attend the walk-in interview on 24 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Technical Support II posts in RARI Pune?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Project Technical Support II post at the Regional Ayurveda Research Institute, Pune.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Project Technical Support II posts?
faq.answer: Candidates should not be more than 30 years of age. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India rules for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Project Technical Support II?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a B.Sc (Biology/Biotechnology/Microbiology) or B.Pharm degree with 2 years of relevant laboratory experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Technical Support II at RARI Pune?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Technical Support II post will receive a salary of Rs. 20,000 per month plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for RARI Pune Project Technical Support II?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Written Test followed by an Interview. Candidates must perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC/SC/ST) for the RARI Pune Project Technical Support II walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in interview for Project Technical Support II?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Project Technical Support II is scheduled for 24 August 2026. Candidates should report at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Regional Ayurveda Research Institute (RARI Pune) office in Pune, Maharashtra. Please refer to the official notification for the exact address.
